scope.order: movement type -> material series -> storage location -> plant prefix -> plant (HCG's order)

rules.lines: purchase scope lines whose material the month's own Item Master flags OUT OF FORMULARY (not the GRN's Formulary column)
rules.actual: abb_mrp = Unit MRP / (100 + Tax %) x 100; total_pp = Base Price x GR Qty; total_mrp = GR Qty x abb_mrp; actual margin = total_mrp - total_pp
rules.suggested: sug_abb = MRP / (100 + GST %) x 100; sug_total_pp = price x GR Qty; sug_total_mrp = sug_abb x GR Qty; suggested margin = sug_total_mrp - sug_total_pp
rules.loss: margin_loss = suggested margin - actual margin, netted (HCG); gain_loss = the lines' positive losses, better_loss = the negative ones

sources.hcg_sheet: HCG's worksheet of the same month, HCG's typed price/MRP/GST
sources.hcg_sheet_pair: HCG's pair for the material from its nearest worksheet month (earlier first), priced by rule PC
sources.hcg_list: HCG's OOF master, the row's own price/MRP/GST
sources.formulary_rule: our rule (Estimated): A same molecule, strength, dosage form and kind; B same molecule, strength and kind; tablet for capsule (or oral liquid for drops); C same molecule, dose, form group and kind; another pack size; D the OOF brand names no dose: same molecule and form group, pack within 4x; F the molecule inside a combination (or the reverse); same strength, form group, kind; within a level: same kind, HCG's P1, most shared descriptor words, nearest pack, sheet order
sources.none: no alternative: shown, adds nothing to the margins or the loss

rules.prices_pc: master row price for a hcg_list brand; else the lowest master price of the brand; else its CASH&TPA FY price, MRP and GST

statuses.counted: in the margins and the loss
statuses.parked: HCG doubts the flag ('Need To check flaging later'): shown, not counted
statuses.unpriced: a suggested brand no price list prices: shown, not counted

rules.guard: with HCG's worksheet of the month, every centre within Rs 1 of HCG's Summary and KR within Rs 1 of HCG's email, else nothing is published; a month HCG's email has figures for but whose workbook was not read is not published either, unless the build is run with --without-hcg-sheet

rules.unit_price: Total Amount without tax / GR Qty (the price after discount, decision D5)
rules.product: molecule_key = molecule (Item Master minor group, salts and synonyms made one) | strength | dosage form | kind; no key when the molecule, strength or form is not written

price_status.no_price: no positive amount or quantity (free or bonus stock, a credit)
price_status.token: a unit price under 0.1% of the line's MRP without GST: a placeholder (Rs 0.01)
price_status.other_unit: priced per strip or pack while the brand is bought per unit (or the reverse)

rules.other_unit: with HCG's CASH&TPA MRP for the brand: the line's MRP more than 4x away from it; else the line's price and MRP both more than 4x away from the brand's month median (lower median)
rules.per_product: over rows with price_status ok and a molecule_key: cheapest = the usual cheapest, the lowest row price (value / qty) at which at least 10% of the product's quantity was bought, counting up from the cheapest; lowest = min unit_price_min; dearest = max unit_price_max; value-weighted price = sum value / sum qty; extra paid = sum over rows of max(0, value - cheapest x qty)
rules.unusually_low: a row priced under 0.5 x its product's usual cheapest: still compared, listed for HCG to check
rules.report: a product varies when its dearest is at least 1% above its cheapest; extra paid per month over all centres

generic.definition: Branded = a product of an originator (innovator) company; generic = every other product (Indian brands, biosimilars, Attis own label, Jan Aushadhi, MNC generic and hospital makers). Estimated definition until HCG confirms it.
